Elbow pain is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't assess it or tell you what it means. Stop loading the joint until someone has looked at it.

I can still change the program for you. Tell me which day the close-grip bench sits on, or just say the session name, and I'll swap it out with the propose_program_edit tool. What would you like it replaced with, or should I leave the choice to the app?
